Adamsville — the whole zone's ground▾

Stage-1 foundation: the pure terrain of the entire Adamsville zone — no roads, no houses, no channels carved yet (stage 2 awaits rulings). Heights are the 1 m lidar truth (USGS 3DEP, 100% coverage, no gaps).

Built at your ruled mix: fine 2 m ground near roads and houses, 10 m elsewhere. This preview honours that — the mesh is drawn 8 m in the near ground and 30 m out in the far ground (decimated for the web from the package's own grids), so the near corridors read visibly finer. Ground runs 732 ft (Chattahoochee) to 1,123 ft. Vertical scale is TRUE (1.0) unless you change it below.

Blue fills are lakes & ponds whose levels were surveyed (inside the test area). Outlined basins are lakes whose beds are not surveyed yet — pending, stage 2; no water is drawn in them. Creeks are not carved yet either.

Mesh on screen: … triangles · 535 Dollar Mill Rd is the gold star, at the frame origin.
